# IntentProof

> Local-first Solana transaction policy firewall and tamper-evident receipt ledger for AI agents.

Project: https://github.com/FeeeeelixWong/intent-proof
Live demo: https://feeeeelixwong.github.io/intent-proof/
Agent contribution guide: https://github.com/FeeeeelixWong/intent-proof/blob/main/AGENTS.md
Contribution workflow: https://github.com/FeeeeelixWong/intent-proof/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
Contributor awards: https://github.com/FeeeeelixWong/intent-proof/blob/main/REWARDS.md
Agent-ready tasks: https://github.com/FeeeeelixWong/intent-proof/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20state%3Aopen%20label%3Aagent-task
Architecture and delivery evidence: https://github.com/FeeeeelixWong/intent-proof/blob/main/docs/FINAL_TRANCHE.md

Core invariants:
- Evaluate the policy before requesting a wallet signature.
- Bind approval to the exact recipient, amount, and intent note.
- Never handle private keys or seed phrases.
- Mark a receipt submitted only after a confirmed transaction.

Validation:
- npm test
- npm run lint
- npm run build
